title: feat(cli): os migrate audit-key-material removes key-material columns from older ledger copies
body:
Fixes #26687
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:新增 `os migrate audit-key-material`,驱动 #26683 已合入的 `migrateKeyMaterialCopies`(热表)与 `migrateArchivedKeyMaterialCopies`(归档数据源),从旧版写入的 `sys_audit_log` / `sys_activity` 账本副本里删除加密密钥材料列;默认 dry run,`--apply` 才写。
- **为什么改**:#26683 只让新写入的副本不再带这些列,旧副本需要运维跑一次命令清理;此前没有入口。
- **风险与回滚**:新命令默认只读,`--apply` 只改副本列、保留 `updated_at`、幂等;另把 `audit-mail-bodies` 的归档判定抽成共享 util(行为与 JSON 输出逐字节不变,其归档集成测试 8/8 绿)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/cli/src/utils/ledger-copy-archive.ts`(从 `audit-mail-bodies.ts` 原样搬出的归档判定,风险点在 `examineArchiveTargets` 的 not-connected / unknown 分类)→ `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-key-material.ts` → `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-mail-bodies.ts` 的删减 hunk。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/audit-key-material.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 4/4 绿(dry run 计数、`--apply` 后 0 份副本带列、重跑无变化)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`os migrate audit-key-material`** (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-key-material.ts`): a new one-shot subcommand that removes the encrypted key-material columns from `sys_audit_log` / `sys_activity` ledger copies 18.2.0 and earlier wrote, then runs the same rewrite over the archive datasource `sys_audit_log` declares. It mirrors `os migrate audit-mail-bodies` flag for flag (`--database-url`, `--apply`, `--yes`, `--force`, `--json`): dry run by default with the read-only boot, the confirmation gate (exit 1 without `--yes` when non-interactive), JSON-only stdout under `--json`, the absent-table read view, and exit 1 when the report counts a failure or an archive target could not be examined.
- **One archive classification for both commands** (`packages/cli/src/utils/ledger-copy-archive.ts`): the archive-target lookup, the declared-connect-failure read and the runtime-datasource-row probe moved out of `audit-mail-bodies.ts` unchanged, so `examined` / `none` / `not-connected` / `unknown` mean the same thing in both commands. `audit-mail-bodies.ts` now calls it; its `--json` document keeps the same keys in the same order.
- **Registered everywhere `audit-mail-bodies` is**: the one-shot family table, the absent-database roster (with two control rows), the `--json` stdout-purity family, the confirmation-exit roster, and the `composeDeclaredDatasources` docblock in `schema-migrate.ts`.
- **Docs**: a command-table row and a `#### os migrate audit-key-material` section in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, and one line in `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` for operators upgrading from 18.2.0 or earlier.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/cli` patch (`Metadata-protocol: none`, so `patch` under the v18 grading).

## Tests

- `audit-key-material.archive.integration.test.ts` (new, 8): the twin of the mail-bodies archive test, over the real Archiver. Dry run counts hot and archived copies and writes nothing; `--apply` leaves 0 copies carrying the columns in either store, keeps every other key and column, and leaves an unlisted object's same-named column alone; a re-run rewrites nothing; a copy still hot at run time is archived without the columns; no run prints a sentinel; `none` / `not-connected` classification and exit codes.
- `audit-key-material.dogfood.test.ts` (new, 4): the real `os` binary over the 18.0 upgrade-harness fixture, which holds 4 `sys_audit_log` and 4 `sys_activity` copies carrying the columns. Dry run counts them byte-identically, `--apply` removes exactly those keys and nothing else, and a re-run is a no-op.
- Roster rows added in `data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts`, `schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration.test.ts`, `json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts` and `migrate-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts`.

<details><summary>Local runs (head f75fee2ba7)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`) and `build`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- CLI unit tier, `vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 339 passed (339), Tests 4927 passed (4927).
- CLI integration tier, the four touched files (`audit-key-material.archive`, `audit-mail-bodies.archive`, `data-commands.absent-database`, `schema-migrate.one-shot-family`): Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 180 passed (180).
- `json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts` (nightly tier, run with `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`): Tests 71 passed (71).
- `migrate-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts`: Tests 36 passed (36), both `audit-key-material` cases included.
- Dogfood `audit-key-material.dogfood.test.ts`: Tests 4 passed (4), 9.6 s. Archive integration: Tests 8 passed (8), 36.9 s (shared agent box).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (fix committed first; restore proven by blob hash)</summary>

- **Runner swapped** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run mode with its own restore trap): the command's destructuring of the key-material runners was pointed at the mail-body runners, so the command boots and reports but removes no key material. Anchor 1 to 0, blob `370c0585` to `d3752c2d`.
  - archive integration: 4 failed / 8 (cases 1 to 4; 0, 5, 6, 7 pin the fixture, output hygiene and classification and stay green);
  - CLI rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in `dist/commands/migrate/audit-key-material.js`; dogfood: 2 failed / 4 (dry-run count, removal after apply).
- **Unregistered** (default export removed): `migrate-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts` 3 failed / 36 (roster equality and both new cases). A first attempt was refused by the tool before running, because its replacement was a substring of the original line and could not be counted; re-run with a countable marker.
- Restore: blob back to `370c0585` == HEAD, `git status --porcelain` empty; CLI rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean over 704 built files; dogfood 4/4 and archive 8/8 green again.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json` item `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json` enumerates the `os migrate` subcommands as variants and its source note says 19; with this command there are 20. Left unedited as dispatched; no checklist gate reads the count (`check-platform-checklist.mjs` and the watchdog both exit 0).
- The upgrade line names "18.2.0 or earlier" because the writer change ships in the release after 18.2.0; it does not guess that release's number.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`: 93 commands. All 93 run; final exit 0 each.
- Three first refused with exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, nothing measured: `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-coverage` read `dist/` of packages outside the CLI closure). After those packages were built they re-ran with exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` over the exit-coded record: 93 derived, 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).
- Families CI runs over the whole workspace are left to the PR's check-runs.

</details>
